2609.05396.title: A Deep Generative Model for Synthesizing Labeled Wireless Signals
2609.05396.paper_summary: Wireless signals with position-related labels are pivotal for both performance evaluation and model training in the realm of wireless sensing. However, acquiring real-world datasets is often challenged by significant measurement and labeling costs. Traditional methods for synthesizing labeled wireless signals typically rely on environmental models, leading to extensive hyper-parameter tuning and inadequate realism for comprehensive model training purposes. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel deep learning (DL)-based method, namely Inter-Instance Generative Adversarial Networks (IIns-GAN), to generate realistic labeled wireless signals. The generated signals are particularly adaptive to different environment scenarios and well-suited for various model training tasks, including distance estimation and environment identification. We have conducted extensive experiments on public Ultra-Wideband (UWB) datasets to evaluate the realism and utility of the generated signals. The results demonstrate that the signals generated by IIns-GAN mirror the physical characteristics of real-world measurements, and significantly contribute to the improvement of model training in diverse wireless sensing tasks.
2609.05396.paper_summary_zh: 無線信號與位置相關的標籤對於無線感測領域的性能評估和模型訓練至關重要。<lb/>然而，獲取現實世界的數據集通常面臨著顯著的測量和標記成本挑戰。<lb/>傳統的合成標記無線信號的方法通常依賴於環境模型，導致需要大量的超參數調整，並且對於全面的模型訓練目的而言，現實性不足。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一種新穎的基於深度學習（DL）的方法，即實例間生成對抗網絡（IIns-GAN），用於生成真實的標記無線信號。<lb/>生成的信號特別適應不同的環境場景，並且非常適合各種模型訓練任務，包括距離估計和環境識別。<lb/>我們在公共的超寬頻（UWB）數據集上進行了廣泛的實驗，以評估生成信號的現實性和實用性。<lb/>結果表明，IIns-GAN生成的信號反映了現實世界測量的物理特徵，並顯著促進了在各種無線感測任務中模型訓練的改進。
